data.one_liner: Widget that displays a BlurHash placeholder and transitions to the real image
data.what_it_does: It decodes a BlurHash string into a blurred image and shows it while the actual image loads. Once loaded it fades to the real image.
use_when: You need a lightweight placeholder for network images
You want a quick visual cue before image download completes
avoid_when: You need to encode images into BlurHash
You require custom image processing beyond decoding
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native dependencies
Supports multiple optimization modes for performance
Works on all Flutter platforms (web, mobile, desktop)
weaknesses: Performance can be slower in standard mode
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides caching, placeholder, and error handling for network images, but not BlurHash decoding
